text:
sara_csm: Heads-up — Maple Health renewal incoming. Procurement (Mary) emailed a few asks: Net60 payment terms, split invoices between US and EU entities, and a vendor_code that doesn't match our ledger. They also want to add +50 seats and keep current unit price but move to a 12mo term. Any blockers on Net60 or DocuSign signoff?

sam_ae: Customer ok on unit price if we agree to 12mo. They want the PO attached to the signing envelope and asked about a prepayment discount (5%) for committing. AE will confirm the discount with execs.

mike_finance: Net60 can work conditionally — we need the vendor_code to match the billing entity and the customer's tax ID. Also flag: Net60 plus split invoices needs Finance + Legal signoff for accounting.

angel_legal: For term extension + seat add, we can do an amendment rather than a new SOW. Net60 is permissible but need clear billing entity mapping (US vs EU) and we should review any cross-border data or indemnity implications. DocuSign is fine; wet-sign could be requested by procurement but would add 5-7 biz days.

katie_enablement: FYI — if seats increase and onboarding shifts, we can allocate one complimentary kickoff session + 10 enablement hrs. Save a slot tentatively.

sara_csm: Pasting Mary's email verbatim: "VendorCode: MAPLE-ENT-002, PO# 987654, prefer Net60, will sign via DocuSign. Invoice allocation: 70% Maple US (billing@maple.us), 30% Maple EU (billing-eu@maple.eu)."

mike_finance: MAPLE-ENT-002 isn't in our vendor registry. Sam — can you request their tax ID and confirm a billing contact for each entity? We prefer a single payor setup but will accept split if paperwork aligns.

sam_ae: On the call with Mary in ~30m. I'll request tax ID, confirm both billing contacts, and push for single payor + PO attached to DocuSign envelope. Will update here.

docsign_bot: DocuSign draft amendment created (internal preview): https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123 — please review signers, attached PO field, and billing contact placeholders.

angel_legal: I'll review the draft now. Quick note: if procurement insists on wet signature we should surface timeline impact to the customer.

sara_csm: :thumbsup: Thanks — if Legal and Finance clear the draft and we get tax IDs today, target to send DocuSign tomorrow. If they insist on wet-sign, flag as a blocker for AE to escalate.

katie_enablement: Holding enablement slot the week after the effective date pending confirmation.

sam_ae: Update from call — Mary gave tax ID 12-3456789 and confirmed PO# 987654 will be attached to the envelope. She said they "prefer" single payor but procurement might still route payments separately; she'll try to consolidate.

sara_csm: Excellent. I'll add this to the renewal tracker and mark "procurement invoice split" as medium risk. Looping back if any further docs are missing.
